$comment: Morse Defender (#188, part of #170), pinned for both ports: DefenderGame in
ios/Sources/MorseKit/Defender.swift and android/.../morsekit/Defender.kt.
Read by ios/Sources/MorseKitCheck/main.swift and
android/app/src/test/.../morsekit/DefenderTest.kt.
Every expected value below was worked out by hand from the rules in
'derivation', not captured from either port. Do not regenerate it to make
a failing test pass; change it only when a rule is meant to change.

rules: Assets (cities, ships) sit along the bottom, each with a callsign.
Attackers launch at the top; each announces its target's callsign in
Morse. Routing a defence to the right asset before the attacker arrives
destroys the attacker; routing to an asset nothing is aimed at wastes
the shot (a miss that breaks the combo); an attacker that arrives
destroys its asset, and any other attacker aimed at that asset is
withdrawn. The assets are the lives: the game is over when none is left.
Timings per wave, then scaled by the difficulty's timeScale (Relaxed
1.35, Normal 1, Fast 0.75 - InvadersDifficulty):
spawnInterval(wave) = max(minSpawnInterval, baseSpawnInterval * spawnDecay^(wave-1)) * timeScale
travelTime(wave)    = max(minTravelTime,    baseTravelTime    * travelDecay^(wave-1)) * timeScale
concurrent(wave)    = min(maxConcurrent, 1 + (wave-1) / 2)   [integer division]
No attacker launches while 'concurrent' are in flight; the spawn clock
holds at the interval so one launches as soon as a slot frees.
Points: pointsPerHit times the combo multiplier
multiplier(combo) = min(4, 1 + (combo-1) / 3)   [integer division]
where combo counts consecutive hits; a wasted shot or a strike resets it.
Every hitsPerWave hits clears a wave. On a wave clear the defence is
reinforced: a new asset (fresh callsign) is added while there are fewer
than maxAssets; at maxAssets the first destroyed asset is rebuilt with a
fresh callsign; with none destroyed nothing happens.
Speed ramp: a game opens startOffset WPM under the learner's character
speed, never under minWpm; every hitsPerStep hits in total steps it up
'step' WPM, capped at the character speed; a strike steps it down 'step',
never under the start; a wasted shot leaves it alone. Callsigns are
multi-character, so Farnsworth spacing IS honoured, at the ramp's
character speed: sendTiming(wpm, farnsworthWpm) is standard timing when
farnsworthWpm is null, otherwise characters at wpm with the effective
speed min(wpm, farnsworthWpm).

difficultyTable.$comment: spawnInterval, travelTime and concurrent per wave and difficulty, from the formulas above; floors bite at wave 10 (spawn) and wave 30 (travel).

sendTiming.name: Farnsworth off: standard timing at the ramp speed
Farnsworth on: characters at the ramp speed, spacing at the effective speed
an effective speed above the ramp speed collapses to standard timing

$comment: Synthetic call-like tokens for the learner's own character set: four
characters, spelled only from the set's letters and digits (anything
else in the set is dropped). Position 1 is a digit when the set has
any, otherwise a letter; the other three are letters, or digits when
the set has no letters. A set with neither falls back to the first two
Koch characters, K and M. 'token' pins the one possible answer where
the alphabet leaves no choice; 'digitAt' is -1 when no digit can appear.
Real callsigns (the full-alphabet option) come from CallsignGenerator
in the everyday US shapes 1x2, 2x1, 1x3 and 2x2: four or five
characters with exactly one digit, at index 1 or 2.

synthetic.name: one digit in the set goes in position 1
one letter and one digit leave no choice
nothing usable falls back to K and M

$comment: characterWpm 33: start 25, target 33. Normal difficulty, the default
asset counts and hitsPerWave. A test drives it with these events:
'hit' routes to the target of the attacker nearest arrival (advancing
the clock until one has launched); 'wrongRoute' routes to a live asset
no attacker is aimed at; 'strike' advances the clock until an attacker
arrives. 'times' repeats the event; the expected state is read after
the last repeat. Hit totals in brackets; combo is the run at that
point. 'assets' counts every asset placed, destroyed ones included;
'live' the ones still standing.

events.note: [4] x2 from the fourth; first ramp step
a wasted shot: combo gone, speed untouched
[6] wave cleared; a fifth asset arrives
an asset lost; the speed steps back
three more lost; never under the start
[18] x2, x2, x3, x3, x3, x4; wave 4; a seventh
[24] all at x4; the eighth asset; at the target speed
[30] at maxAssets: the first of the four destroyed is rebuilt; capped at the target
[36] x1 x1 x1 x2 x2 x2; another rebuilt
[42] x3 x3 x3 x4 x4 x4; another rebuilt
[54] the last one rebuilt: every asset standing
[60] at maxAssets with none destroyed: nothing to rebuild

loss.$comment: Never route: every attacker strikes. With the default four starting assets and no wave clears, the fourth strike ends the game and clears the field.
